args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were caught in a time loop lasting a little under an hour [2]. The mechanism of this loop is that when it ends and starts again, anyone inside who cannot "feel it" forgets the entire turn and lives it fresh [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but have spent nine years repeatedly walking into the manufactory, forgetting their progress every hour [2].

Odeline Marran is able to remember every turn because she is one of the few who can "hold the deep Facets back" and avoid being reset to the threshold [7]. While others are reset and their memories wiped when the hour turns, Ode has remained conscious of the repetitions, living the same hour for nine years [5, 6].
